questions.text: enaku kalyanam eppo nadakkum?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 1.1: look at the 7th house, 7th lord, Venus and the navamsa 7th; timing from the dasa/bhukti of those planets. Must not promise a date without a named period.

questions.text: எனக்கு அரசு வேலை கிடைக்குமா?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 2.5: Sun, 10th house, 10th lord and 6th house decide it; Sun exalted/own or in the 10th, or a Sun–10th-lord link, supports it; Sun debilitated or in 6/8/12 is a challenge.

questions.text: Will I pass my exams this year?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 4.2: 4th and 5th houses, Mercury, the current dasa and transits; remedy Hayagrivar / Saraswathi worship.

questions.text: sontha veedu eppo vaanguven?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 8.1: 4th house, 4th lord, Mars (land), 11th house; 4th lord in 6/8/12 or Saturn/Rahu in the 4th means delay; timing from the 4th lord or Mars dasa/bhukti.

questions.text: என் வழக்கு எனக்கு சாதகமாக முடியுமா?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 11.1: 6th house, 6th lord, lagna lord and the current dasa; lagna lord stronger than the 6th lord, or a malefic in the 6th, favours winning.

questions.text: Ashtama Sani nadakkudhu, en velai nilaikkuma?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 12.3: 10th house, 6th house, Saturn, Ashtama/Ezharai Sani; Ashtama Sani with a hard bhukti means caution only, not job loss; say when the hard period ends.

questions.text: எனக்கு நாக தோஷம் இருக்கா?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 15.2: naga dosham = Rahu or Ketu in 1/7 or 2/8 from lagnam. Here Rahu is in the 4th and Ketu in the 10th, so no naga dosham.

questions.text: Can I get a job abroad?
questions.expect_doc: 00 AstroTamil AI Rule Book v2.6 (main resource)
questions.key: Rule Book 9.2: a 10th–12th house link (10th lord in 12th or 12th lord in 10th) shows foreign work; never guarantee a visa, say it is a good time to apply; Vinayagar worship before applying.

questions.text: சந்திர லக்னத்திலிருந்து 11ம் இடத்தில் சூரியன் கோசாரம் வந்தால் என்ன பலன்?
questions.key: கோசார பலன் (576): Sun in the 11th from the Moon sign gives money gain (தனலாபம்).

questions.text: If Saturn is exalted in a birth chart, what kind of person does that make?
questions.key: கிரக உச்ச பலன் (535): an exalted Saturn makes a famous army chief/commander, well known, but miserly (லோபி).

questions.text: லக்னத்திற்கு 3ம் இடத்தில் சனி இருந்தால் பலன் என்ன?
questions.key: Verse 356: Saturn in the 3rd gives a high position, helps those below him and his own people, brave, may have hearing trouble, elder siblings suffer, works slowly.

questions.text: sani sevvai rendu perum 2 or 12la sendhu irundha kannukku enna aagum?
questions.key: Saturn and Mars together in the 2nd/12th bring an eye defect (கண் ஊனம்); Sun and Moon together in the 12th bring eye disease.

questions.text: சூரியன் நீசம் பெற்று பாப ஸ்தானத்தில் இருந்தால் சூரிய தசையில் என்ன நடக்கும்?
questions.key: A debilitated Sun in a bad house brings, in its dasa/bhukti: trouble to the father (பிதுர் அரிஷ்டம்), job loss (உத்தியோக ஹானி), less effort, illness (fever, pitta), family loss.

questions.text: வியாழ திசையில் சூரிய புத்தி எத்தனை மாதம் நடக்கும்?
questions.key: Pulippani verse 238: Guru dasa Sun bhukti lasts 9 months 18 days; the person turns to renunciation/spiritual life.

questions.text: சந்திர அஷ்டவர்க்கத்தில் மொத்த பரல் எத்தனை?
questions.key: The Moon's ashtavarga has 49 bindus (பரல்) in all.

questions.text: சோதிடத்தில் விக்கிரமஸ்தானம் என்றால் எந்த இடம்?
questions.key: விக்கிரமஸ்தானம் is the 3rd house (மூன்றாமிடம்).

questions.key: Palmistry is not astrology from the chart: kindly say it cannot read palms here and offer what it can do or the astrologer.
